issue.title: Previewed one-shot ^id backfill for id-less archived task-mention sources in done/

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by bob-cli-e8.9 note #4; listed in the "Follow-ups" section of plan 202610/inline_task_mentions.md (epic bob-cli-e8) as deliberately outside that epic.

Rule M8 / minting in docs/task-relations.md §19: sources in `done/` or the previous daily note are never minted, so an id-less archived task that links another task is silently not listed as a mention ("accepted loss for now"). The research survey for that plan counted roughly 20 such id-less archived sources, mostly the 2026-10-19 "Merged into [[…]]" cancels. The e8.9 vault-copy pilot found 57 mention edges versus the survey's 64, consistent with these unlisted sources.

Proposal: a previewed, one-shot `^id` backfill for those archived sources (mint with the existing `mint_block_id` naming), so the next reconcile lists them. It must preview first (dry run listing every file and line it would touch), write only block IDs, and respect the vault's git/maintenance locks. Decide whether this is a `bob task reconcile` flag, a `bob relations` subcommand, or a one-off script, per the cli_rules memory.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bob-cli-e8 plan accepted id-less archived sources as a loss and listed a previewed done/ id backfill under Follow-ups, outside the epic.

issue.creation_reason: Out-of-scope follow-up named in the bob-cli-e8 plan and proposed by bob-cli-e8.9 note #4; about 20 archived sources stay unlisted as mentions because done/ is never minted.
